    • importCollection

      @PostMapping(value="/{id}/collections/{collectionName}/import", consumes="multipart/form-data") @Secured({"ROLE_ADMIN","STORE_EDIT"}) public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<TurStoreImportResult> importCollection(@PathVariable String id, @PathVariable String collectionName, @RequestParam("file") org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile file, @RequestParam(value="embeddingModelId",required=false) String embeddingModelId)
      Imports a JSONL file (optionally wrapped in a ZIP) into a collection. The file shape mirrors the export endpoint: 
      { "id": "...", "content": "...", "embedding": [...], "metadata": {...} }
      Records that already carry an embedding are upserted verbatim. Records with a missing/empty embedding are re-embedded by the LLM resolved from embeddingModelId (or, when omitted, the Global Settings default), so third-party datasets without precomputed vectors can still be imported in one click.
      Since:
      2026.2.4

    • exportCollection

      @GetMapping(value="/{id}/collections/{collectionName}/export", produces="application/zip") @Secured({"ROLE_ADMIN","STORE_VIEW"}) public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.StreamingResponseBody> exportCollection(@PathVariable String id, @PathVariable String collectionName)
      Streams every chunk in the collection as a single JSONL entry inside a ZIP archive. JSONL keeps each row independent so consumers can stream the file line-by-line; the ZIP wrapper compresses the (verbose) embedding vectors and yields a single, easy-to-share artifact.
      Since:
      2026.2.4
